owner_words: For light mode: Can we reduce the wave animation density at midclose to closer up zooms starting where when you can see the entire state name labels appear on the map and inward? Maybe 15-20% less dense? For beach mode from zoom where you can see city names on the label and closer, reduce the wave animation density 10-15%? And dark mode as well. But starting from two zooms closer in than beach mode. And only at areas where there are bigger surf does this affect, because bigger animations take over the screen. You might need to test the zoom levels for this as well using special tools and art.
Give it all one more pass with special art skills to make sure we're making the crests as pleasing as possible to the eye with the themes color scheme in place
scope: crest seed density only (DRAW_VS threshold; engine uniform); no colour, no served number (no SCOREBOARD row)

labels.finding: all three styles spell every state out from z5 (state-label steps on zoom 5); city names exist from z2.5 (big ones); beach's local coastal towns fill in at z6

rule.meaning: cut = how much LESS of the screen big-surf crests cover (as the eye sees it, owner pick 2026-10-21, D-039)
rule.mechanism: a crest goes when crestCutHash(vec2(col,row)) < share x height gate x zoom ramp; its density threshold then goes to -2 (2026-10-21 15Z; before: the threshold was scaled, see as_seen_fit.hash_finding)
rule.kill: window.__RAW_DISABLE_CREST_DENSITY_ZOOM__ = true: dev DRAW_VS byte for byte (sha256 a1683763...)
rule.measurement_knob: window.__RAW_CREST_DENSITY_SEED_CUT__ (live, clamped 0-0.9, inside the ramp); the VISIBLE A/B lever is gone

crest_area_by_height: DRAW_VS halfLength 18->40 px, halfThickness 3->8 px by smoothstep(0.1, 4.0, h): area x~4 from 1 m to 4 m
coverage_note: mid view (z5.5) nulls run 3-15 pts (the storm moves between captures): not read. Coastal and close nulls <= 0.9 pts.

art_pass.method: design critique (design:design-critique) of the engine stills in all three themes, plus the checker on candidates
findings: close-zoom big surf: crests cover ~90% of the frame in every theme and hide the wash (the height)
light's lemon storm (1.00, 0.96, 0.00), C* 94, is loud over large areas
beach's v1 magenta crests on its v1 sea and dark's orange crests on its hot-pink storm wash read hue-only in places (owned by #416 / #419)

warm_gold_candidate.engine: local uncommitted variant wg (window.__RAW_LIGHT_STORM_WARM__ in a scratch build only); coverage within 0.6-2.6 pts of v2

as_seen_fit.owner_words: Ship #428's density cut as the eye sees it (coverage-calibrated), fitted per theme. Also switch light's storm to the warm gold in its own PR.
as_seen_fit.instrument: scn_density_sweep.js (one browser session per theme; the live knob or the shipped rows; paired crest-free frames) + crest_coverage.py (share of the clip differing > 10/255 from its crest-free frame); synthetic storm, centre (-105.2, 18.4)

run1_threshold_sweep_one_pass.note: cuts 0/15/30/45/60% in one pass, 11 s settle: drift after each zoom jump folded into the cuts (superseded)

hash_finding.method: numpy float32: index x 12.9898, phase = fract(x / 2pi) in float32 (GPU-style range reduction), sin, x 43758.5453, fract
hash_finding.cut_hash: crestCutHash(vec2(col,row)): Dave Hoskins hash12 (hash without sine), float32
